department: Mechanical Engineering, Fluids and Aeronautics (ETSEIAAT / ETSEIB)

deadline.value: Applications are accepted throughout the academic year under UPC's general rule; the programme page sets no separate date.
deadline.quote: As a general rule, you can apply for a doctoral programme throughout the academic year.

supervisor.value: The programme overview says a possible tutor is consulted, but does not make a supervisor a condition of admission.

funding.value: UPC predoctoral grants are awarded through annual general calls; the programme pages do not say how many students are funded.
funding.quote: General calls of predoctoral grants, financed by state and autonomous public bodies, the UPC, and private foundations.

entry_route.value: Applicants should hold a master's degree, or 60 ECTS of master's credits, in a related area.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should also have completed a master's degree (or 60 ECTS master's degree credits) in an area related to the scientific field of the programme.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the programme pages.

notes: The department's own admission site was not fetched. Admission is by a 40% personal contact step with questionnaires, exercises and telephone interviews.
